purpose: Test whether absolute pre-match Elo level (strong-v-strong versus weak-v-weak at the same Elo gap) adds stable Draw information beyond the frozen R39W strength/balance feature family in time-ordered competition-season folds.

folding.train_rule: same-competition rows strictly before the first date of the test season

elo_level_feature.rationale: R39U already uses elo_difference_with_home_advantage; mean Elo is the orthogonal absolute matchup-strength level not represented by a difference alone

models.baseline_draw: R39W frozen 9-feature binary Draw logistic, L2=10
models.challenger_draw: baseline 9 features plus elo_mean_pre_match, binary Draw logistic L2=10
models.conditional_HA: R39W frozen conditional Home-vs-Away logistic on non-draws, L2=10; identical for baseline and challenger
models.solver: deterministic Newton/IRLS with backtracking line search

frozen_gate.coverage: elo-level eligible test rows / baseline finite test rows >= 0.995
frozen_gate.fold_draw_log_loss_wins: challenger wins at least 55% of eligible folds
frozen_gate.competition_draw_log_loss_wins: challenger wins at least 60% of competitions with at least two eligible folds
frozen_gate.if_pass: Absolute Elo level is a stable incremental Draw information family and may proceed to a separately preregistered confirmation; no formal promotion.
frozen_gate.if_fail: Close absolute-Elo Draw route; no post-result nonlinear/L2/threshold tuning on this evaluation.
